notes: Dead drone: a dead quad-rotor maintenance drone, one arm snapped, lens dark, scorched. Salvage it for a chance of a component. Frames are the piece turned [0, 90, 180, 270] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them wrap (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node.
